source.name: USDA Crop-CASMA daily NDVI via WCS
source.note: the layer the GISit repo records as broken on a projection error; the fix is lon/lat to Albers metres

mask: USDA Cropland Data Layer class 42 dry beans, 2025, 0.03 degree cells
unit: one entry per growing REGION, acreage-weighted across its bean cells
caveat: the 2025 crop mask is applied to every year back to 2000
scaling: 8-bit digital number, undocumented by the service; monotonic in greenness, which is all a model needs
quality_rule: a region-date is marked suspect when its median sits at or below the no-data floor (130) AND the spread between median and 90th percentile is under 10 counts. Across 700-odd cells a real scene always has spread; a flat floor is cloud or an empty scene. Suspect readings are kept in the record and excluded from every model and comparison.
